kinetren
Docs

User guide

Keyboard and mouse

Every key and mouse gesture kinetren understands. The keys work during playback and from the detached preview window too. While you type into a text field, the keys go to the field.

Transport

KeysAction
Spaceplay / pause
Space twice quicklystop at the region start, or at the project start when there is no region
hold Spaceplay faster, ramping up to 4× over five seconds; release to return to the normal speed
A / Homeback to the previous marker, region edge or event edge
D / Endforward to the next marker, region edge or event edge; after the last one, the end of the project
Shift+Home / Shift+Endthe very start / end of the project
Ctrl+Ltype a timecode to jump to

When the region has been played to its end, Space plays it again from its start. With the loop on, it starts from the region start when the playhead is outside the region.

Editing

KeysAction
Ssplit at the playhead: the selected events, or every event under the playhead when nothing is selected
Delete / Backspacedelete the selected morphers and cameras; otherwise every event crossing the region; otherwise the selected events
Ctrl+Ccopy what lies in the region, or the selected events when there is no region
Ctrl+Vpaste at the playhead, on the track under the mouse; the playhead moves to the end of the pasted block, so pasting again chains copies
Ctrl+Zundo
Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Yredo
Ctrl+Ssave
Alt+M / Alt+Smute / solo the track of the selected event, or the track under the mouse
Ctrl+Fsearch events, markers, tracks, media and bin groups by name: ↑ / ↓ choose, Enter jumps, Esc closes
Escstep back, one thing per press: close the speed field, search or the top window, cancel a drag, clear the region and the selection (the loop stays on), then collapse an expanded reel, then leave the reel

Pasting events that have names first asks for a name prefix: Enter pastes, Esc cancels. Cutting the region's interior out of the events is Cut out the region interior in the menu of a track's empty space.

Region and markers

KeysAction
I / Oregion start / end at the playhead; with no region, I starts a one-second region
Shift+A / Shift+Djump back / forward and drag the left / right region edge along; with no region, select the stretch just jumped over
Lloop the region on / off
Madd a marker at the playhead, or remove the one next to it; with the playhead inside the region, add or remove a range marker over the region
drag a markermove it
drag a region edgemove it
double-click a range marker on the rulerregion over it, with its events selected
Shift+double-click an eventregion over the event and its linked partners

Reels

KeysAction
Enter on a selected reelexpand it in place; on an expanded one, enter the reel
double-click a reelexpand it in place / collapse it
Esccollapse the expanded reel; again — leave the reel you entered
drag the edge of an expanded reel's windowresize the instance

View and zoom

KeysAction
wheelscroll along time
Ctrl+wheel / pinchzoom around the mouse
Shift+wheelscroll tracks
Ctrl+Shift+wheelchange all track heights, keeping the track under the mouse in place
click near the left / right edge of the tracksplace the playhead there and jump the view that way
drag past the edge of the tracksthe view scrolls along

Mouse on the timeline

KeysAction
click the rulermove the playhead (it snaps to markers)
drag the playhead on the rulerscrub
drag on the ruler or on empty spaceregion
click empty spacemove the playhead
Ctrl+drag on empty spacerubber-band selection
click an eventselect it and move the playhead there
Ctrl+click an eventadd it to the selection or take it out; the playhead stays
drag an eventmove it, the selection moves together; drop it over a neighbour for a crossfade
Ctrl while draggingswitch the magnet off
drag an event's edgetrim
drag a top corner of an eventfade at that edge
drag the level lineopacity (video) / gain (audio)
double-click the level linefull opacity / 0 dB
double-click an eventeffects window
drag a transition's edge / its cutresize / roll the edit
double-click a transitiontransition properties
drag a morpher or a camera, or its edgesmove / resize
double-click a morpher / a cameramorpher editor / camera properties
drag an area's edgeresize the area
click a track badge M / S / lock / FXmute / solo / lock / track window
double-click a track headerrename the track
drag a track header / its bottom edgereorder / change its height
right-click a track header → Reset heightback to the default height
right-click anythingits menu

With the Selection tool button on, a plain drag on empty space selects events, and Ctrl+drag adds to the selection.

Windows and panels

KeysAction
click the previewplay / pause
double-click the previewdetach it into its own window; in that window — put it back
Esc in the detached previewput the preview back
right-click the previewframe controls
double-click the timecodetype a position
digits, Backspace, Enter, Esc in the timecodedigits fill from the right, a pasted timecode is laid in whole; Enter jumps, Esc cancels
Shift+click the Back / Forward buttonsjump and drag the region edge along
drag the top / bottom half of the speed stripconstant speed / shuttle (release to return)
Shift while dragging the speed stripfine adjustment
double-click the speed stripback to 1×
right-click or Ctrl+click the speed striptype a speed from 0.01 to 8, a minus plays backwards; Enter applies, Esc cancels
drag the fader or turn the wheel over itpreview volume, 1 dB per wheel step
Shift+wheel over the fader0.2 dB per step
double-click the fader0 dB
click the M button at the bottom of the metersmute / unmute the preview
click a card in the media binplace it at the playhead
Ctrl+click / Shift+click a cardadd it to the bin selection or take it out
drag a cardonto the timeline, or to another spot in the bin
drag across the bin backgroundselect cards with a frame; Ctrl or Shift adds to the selection
double-click a generator cardits parameters
click / drag / cross on a slot of the effect chainselect / reorder / remove
double-click a parameter labelreset the parameter to its default
right-click a parameter label inside a reelpublish the parameter of the composition
click empty space in the curve graphadd a key to the active curve
drag / double-click / right-click a keymove it / delete it / its menu
wheel / Ctrl+wheel over the curve graphscroll / zoom the graph
drag the graph's rulermove the main playhead
drag a segment's handle; Shift+drag sidewaysthe curve's tension or amplitude; the number of periods
Ctrl+click the key-before / key-after buttonlock every curve of the slot, not just one
Tab / Enter in a formula fieldcomplete a name / apply
drag a point of the equalizer graphits frequency and gain
wheel over the middle point of a bandits Q
drag the picture / a corner / the rotate handle / the anchor dot / a crop side in the transform framemove / scale / rotate / move the anchor / crop
Shift while rotating15° steps
Alt while grabbing in the transform framea wider grab zone for the anchor dot
Enter / Esc while renaming a track, marker, area, card or published parametersave / cancel the name
drag / double-click the title barmove the window / maximize or restore it

The status line always shows what the thing under the mouse does.
